author: smcarus
title: Will Turkey's inflation be lower in 2026 than in 2025?
summary: Give the probability that IMF WEO average consumer price inflation for Turkey is lower for 2026 than for 2025, both as first read on or after 1 May 2027 (after the April 2027 WEO).
knownLimits: The 2026 figure in the April 2027 WEO is still an IMF estimate and may be revised later; the first reading stands.
This is the average for the year, not the change from December to December.
